map.输入初始投资、折现率和未来现金流，评估项目当前价值: Enter initial investment, discount rate and future cash flows to assess the project's present value
map.NPV = 初始投资 + Σ(第 t 期现金流 / (1+r)^t): NPV = initial investment + Σ(cash flow at period t / (1+r)^t)
map.基于折现现金流法：NPV 为初始投资与各期现金流按折现率 r 折现之和；NPV: Based on the discounted cash flow method: NPV is the initial investment plus each cash flow discounted at rate r; NPV > 0 means the project is viable, used for investment comparison and capital budgeting.
map.先阅读NPV (Net Present Value) Calculator的输入: First read the input instructions of the NPV (Net Present Value) Calculator, run it once with a reproducible example and record the result.
map.示例：初始 -10 万、折现率 8%、5 期各 3 万: Example: initial −100k, discount rate 8%, 30k each of 5 periods
